history.name: A refusal names the fix
history.description: Every refusal prints as one plain line addressed to whoever ran the command, naming what was wrong and what to do instead — the command to run, the field to supply, the areas that do exist. Nothing is reported as a crash, and the exit status makes a failure usable in a commit hook or a build.
history.dev_notes: UserError in src/util.mjs, printed without a stack by bin/ledger.mjs; LEDGER_DEBUG=1 adds the stack for a genuine bug.
